arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS fraud_transactions, COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id) AS distinct_users FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) JOIN cards c ON c.id = t.card_id WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions labelled as fraud and the distinct users who made them, linking transactions to users through cards.
assumptions: A transaction's user is the owner of its card (cards.user_id).
Only transactions with a fraud label are counted; unlabelled transactions are excluded.
